name: Seven Days
source:
The protagonist returns home after a long absence.
However, he is greeted by his younger brother, who suddenly became incredibly unfriendly to him...?
Will his brother be able to smile again before he returns to his apartment?
translation:
The protagonist returns home after a long absence.
However, he is greeted by his younger brother, who suddenly became incredibly unfriendly to him...?
Will his brother be able to smile again before he returns to his apartment?
